note: Hand-curated provenance records. Facts are separated from judgements: `evidence` lists what was actually observed and where; `grade` is the BLOXEN provenance grade of the ARTIFACT (this exact file), not of the game's historical existence. File names are never treated as provenance. No place may be marked playable until its scripts have a safe runtime; importing/replicating geometry is not playability.

source.readme: games are untested and may be duplicates or broken; no per-place provenance
